notes.title: Modified content of the game test version
notes.content:
Regarding the game test version and the official version, the following adjustments have been made:

1.Fix game bugs
2.Adjust game values
3. Game play modifications
4. Add game operation tips

  
*The angel statue will appear only when the sin gauge is full, and the location will be different each time.
  
  Players must find the angel statue and pray within the time to obtain the treasure chest.

* There are random weapons, soul stones and other rewards in the treasure box

*If the prayer is not completed within the time, divine punishment will occur

notes.title: The Battle Of Sacred Heart_Voice of Developers
notes.content:
Hello everyone, This is game developer KENCHI

This game is my first independent game

Starting around August 2021, after various trial and error modifications, the current development work is still in progress

This game has participated in the activities of the New Product Festival in June

So there will be an opportunity for a public Demo Play

You are welcome to add to the wish list first, and you can receive the message notification as soon as possible



 I would also like to thank everyone who added this game to the wishlist or is interested

Let the lonely developer know that someone is looking forward to the game he makes


What kind of game is Sacred Heart War?
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------------
The core of this game is similar to the arena in The Witcher 2. Players gain skills and equipment from the battle in the arena to build their own fighting style.Challenge waves of more and stronger enemies


Can the player choose which character to use?
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------------
At present, players can only use Sacred Heart nun Cynthia, through the game you can get R coins to change the character skin


How difficult is the game?
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------------
The game has no difficulty setting, but players can also choose unarmed combat without weapons or build a fighting style without blood recovery skills to play to increase the challenge
   
The enemies in the game, especially the devil, each legion will have different special skills, players may have to try different attack methods to pass the level smoothly
   
In addition, people who are not good at action games can also make good use of their comrades to reverse the situation


Is it possible to execute the enemy?
-------------------------------------------------- -------------------------------------------------- ------------
Powerful enemies, such as elites and devils, will have toughness. When the toughness of the enemy is weakened, it will cause unbalanced dizziness

At this time, the player has a chance to execute the enemy with a single knife, (ex. The lower the enemy's blood volume, the higher the probability of successful execution)


[previewyoutube=Z5UFaU-1wfw;full][/previewyoutube]


The above simple Q&A helps everyone to quickly understand this game, and it will be updated from time to time in the future

If you have any questions, please leave a message, thank you~
